subtitle: Melbourne's only legal nudist beach, whose 1986 status a council nearly revoked in 2022 over syringes in the carpark.
spike_statement: A 2022 council report on drugs and syringes nearly ended Melbourne's only legal nudist beach; 92% of 4,000 said keep it, but the fixes never came.

levers.photo_tone: Sandstone bluffs above a flat gray-blue bay, the Sunnyside Road carpark empty at first light
